messages.text: So when I purchased this miner it was advertised as a 10 terahesh but after I received it I only saw about 8.2 8.3 consistently. I brought this up in the discord. And JD said I needed to message you guys in here regarding it and you were doing something as compensation for that. Because I still have the screenshots showing that it was a 10-terrahash when I purchased it

You're right, and JD sent you to the right place. That's the Bitfortun BS-2. Bitfortun measured hashrate at the pool level and padded a fixed figure in the firmware, so the number on the listing was off. We corrected it and we're compensating everyone who bought one, no screenshots needed.

What's your order number? I'll pull it up and get your compensation moving.
What's the email on the order? That's all I need with the number to pull it up.
Handed to the team · BS-2 10TH/s advertised vs ~8.2 actual; customer came from Discord per JD. Needs

Got it, Shop····, the BS-2 delivered September 18. The order already shows a refund back to your card for the hashrate difference, so that part's done on our side. The $50 coupon code goes to this email.

I've pinged Abel and Georges to confirm the code is out. Stay in the chat and one of them will jump in here. If you step away, you'll get it by email.
Never received a refund regarding that. I received a $75 partial refund because I left you a review on Google and send it to you because the coupon code was never applied to my original order
Handed to the team · Correction to my earlier flag: the partial refund on this order is not the hashr

Understood, that $75 was the review refund, separate thing. So the BS-2 hashrate compensation still hasn't reached you, and it should have.

I've put that in front of Abel and Georges with your order and what's actually been paid out, so nothing gets counted twice. One of them will jump into this chat to confirm the refund and the code. Stay here if you can, otherwise it comes to this email.
Thanks for the patience on this one. Sit tight, they'll pick it up here.
